source_observation: One combined catch-and-turn sprite: mermaid's back/hair still turned to viewer, eyes and facial features concealed by sweeping yellow hair with cyan band. Her long green tail leaves her waist at right, sweeps left and then sharply rises to forked fin at upper-left. Johnny remains mostly hidden behind her torso and hair, crouching on right with black trouser legs and two bare feet staggered low. His bent near arm wraps beneath her waist while far arm supports her upper back; her two arms fold around his neck. Sparse white circular motion/water strokes at left. Keep exact rear-facing overlap.
